ownership_rule: Each capability has exactly one canonical owner. Routes and tests reference IDs; they do not redefine semantics.

capabilities.expected: select one execution mode before routing
capabilities.forbidden: infer write permission from silence or a read-only request

capabilities.expected: separate authorization, epistemic truth, project choice, state and procedure
capabilities.forbidden: resolve different authority dimensions with one total priority list

capabilities.expected: validate mode-object-action-state against route contract
capabilities.forbidden: use a catchall or transitive legacy link as proof of routing

capabilities.expected: one canonical owner per semantic capability
capabilities.forbidden: duplicate normative ownership

capabilities.expected: use the discriminated V9 receipt contract and route-consistent modules
capabilities.forbidden: invent a second receipt schema

capabilities.expected: classify new_design, change_existing or not_applicable
capabilities.forbidden: force greenfield work into keep_current

capabilities.expected: track question, shared_data, artifact and project with type-specific states
capabilities.forbidden: treat one current_stage as project-wide authority

capabilities.expected: continue from direct state and inputs without full reread
capabilities.forbidden: create a recovery manifest for ordinary continuation

capabilities.expected: review affected components and direct consumers
capabilities.forbidden: escalate a local change to full-project reading without cause

capabilities.trigger: invalid state, identity conflict, unlocalizable change, explicit full recovery or closure
capabilities.expected: reconstruct complete evidence coverage
capabilities.forbidden: claim recovery from a narrative summary alone

capabilities.expected: require consumer, purpose, lifecycle, class and authorization
capabilities.forbidden: create placeholders or speculative directories

capabilities.expected: validate artifact and update state registry
capabilities.forbidden: promote unvalidated scratch output

capabilities.expected: identify questions, shared evidence, deliverables and boundaries
capabilities.forbidden: invent unsupported tasks

capabilities.expected: materialize only immediately consumed structure
capabilities.forbidden: eagerly create the full legacy scaffold

capabilities.expected: link work packages, dependencies, evidence and deliverables
capabilities.forbidden: let orchestration detail override V9 state or recovery contracts

capabilities.trigger: literature or external factual evidence needed
capabilities.expected: search authoritative sources and record claim-level use
capabilities.forbidden: treat search snippets or AI answers as primary evidence

capabilities.trigger: external data, facts, figures or references
capabilities.expected: record source, license, identity and claim linkage
capabilities.forbidden: claim full-text review when only an abstract was read

capabilities.expected: establish source, schema, units, time-space scope and immutable raw identity
capabilities.forbidden: silently overwrite raw data

capabilities.expected: audit completeness, validity, duplicates, missingness, outliers and semantic consistency
capabilities.forbidden: clean before documenting evidence

capabilities.expected: decide and justify treatment with sensitivity to alternatives
capabilities.forbidden: apply irreversible treatment without a decision

capabilities.expected: freeze processed identity, lineage and consumer contract
capabilities.forbidden: change the frozen dataset without invalidating consumers

capabilities.expected: translate the question into objects, variables, constraints, objectives and outputs
capabilities.forbidden: choose an algorithm before defining the mathematical problem

capabilities.expected: compare viable candidate models using explicit criteria
capabilities.forbidden: pretend a single unexamined method is a comparison

capabilities.expected: freeze assumptions, symbols, equations, parameters, units and interfaces
capabilities.forbidden: implement an ambiguous specification

capabilities.expected: implement reproducibly with deterministic inputs and inspectable outputs
capabilities.forbidden: substitute code structure for model specification

capabilities.expected: connect results to question, baseline and limitations
capabilities.forbidden: report unexplained number lists

capabilities.expected: check code paths, interfaces, units, boundaries and reproducibility
capabilities.forbidden: equate process exit zero with correctness

capabilities.expected: check recalculation, tolerances, convergence and numerical identity
capabilities.forbidden: hide numerical instability behind formatting

capabilities.expected: check constraints, invariants, limiting cases, counterexamples and sensitivity
capabilities.forbidden: claim robustness from one nominal run

capabilities.trigger: model is examined for use or claim
capabilities.expected: check assumptions, parameters, scale, mechanisms and reality fit
capabilities.forbidden: use implementation verification as a substitute for model examination

capabilities.expected: complete both solution verification and model examination
capabilities.forbidden: close S6 with only one axis

capabilities.expected: quantify or bound uncertainty and propagate it to claims
capabilities.forbidden: attach generic limitation prose without analysis

capabilities.expected: define perturbations, metrics, baselines and decision impact
capabilities.forbidden: call visual similarity a robustness proof

capabilities.expected: give each section a clear question-facing responsibility and dependency order
capabilities.forbidden: mirror the work log or internal project state in the paper

capabilities.expected: explain objects, data, derivation, results and meaning for a reader
capabilities.forbidden: use formula or number dumping as explanation

capabilities.expected: audit comprehension without relying on code or internal notes
capabilities.forbidden: let audit meta-language leak into evaluator-visible prose

capabilities.trigger: claim manuscript section or full paper complete
capabilities.expected: apply global and section-specific acceptance criteria
capabilities.forbidden: aggregate local passes into a full-paper pass without scope evidence

capabilities.expected: edit and recheck the local dependency surface only
capabilities.forbidden: force a full manuscript audit for a typo-only change

capabilities.trigger: user or project explicitly selects the profile
capabilities.expected: apply profile without overriding correctness or official format
capabilities.forbidden: activate a personal profile by default

capabilities.expected: choose a visual that answers a defined reader question
capabilities.forbidden: create decorative visuals without information purpose

capabilities.expected: verify readability, fonts, pagination, captions and placement
capabilities.forbidden: claim layout success from source inspection alone

capabilities.trigger: visual consumes data or model output
capabilities.expected: preserve data identity, units, legend and provenance
capabilities.forbidden: manually alter plotted values

capabilities.expected: check required files, reproducibility, rendering and submission boundaries
capabilities.forbidden: deliver temporary or unverified artifacts

capabilities.expected: close citation, license and source lineage
capabilities.forbidden: ship unverifiable external assets

capabilities.expected: synchronize authoritative state, open items and next legal action
capabilities.forbidden: use a narrative summary as the only handoff

capabilities.expected: classify change type and L0-L4 risk
capabilities.forbidden: treat every edit as an append-only wording patch

capabilities.expected: calculate capability, route, state, schema, module and test impact
capabilities.forbidden: edit before checking callers and conflicts

capabilities.expected: modify or assign exactly one canonical owner
capabilities.forbidden: add a second normative copy

capabilities.expected: add positive, near-miss negative and mixed/conflict cases
capabilities.forbidden: claim behavior from wording-only tests

capabilities.expected: verify with a fresh invocation that reloads the new skill
capabilities.forbidden: self-certify changed behavior in the editing context

capabilities.expected: preserve prior release and explicit rollback point
capabilities.forbidden: overwrite the only stable release
